checks.text: The page heading reads "Spreadsheet App" and the sheet tab bar shows a tab labelled "Sheet1".
Clicking the cell in row 1, column A (labelled "A1") and typing "10" then pressing Enter shows "10" in cell A1.
Clicking the cell in row 1, column B (labelled "B1") and typing "=A1*2" then pressing Enter shows "20" in cell B1.

Clicking the cell in row 2, column A (labelled "A2") and typing "5" then pressing Enter shows "5" in cell A2; clicking the cell in row 2, column B (labelled "B2") and typing "=A2*2" then pressing Enter shows "10" in cell B2.
Clicking the button labelled "Add sheet" creates a new tab labelled "Sheet2" and switches to it; the grid is empty and cell A1 is blank.
Clicking the tab labelled "Sheet1" returns to the first sheet; cell A1 shows "10" and cell B1 shows "20".
Clicking the button labelled "Export CSV" copies the current sheet's data to the clipboard; the clipboard contains the text "A,B\n10,20\n5,10".
Clicking the cell in row 1, column B (labelled "B1") and typing "=A1+100" then pressing Enter shows "110" in cell B1, replacing the previous value.
Reload keeps the sheet named "Sheet1" with cell A1 showing "10" and cell B1 showing "110".
